description: Revert to the most stable baseline configuration (8 layers, 128 head dim, 128 batch size, 0% warmup, 0.06 Matrix LR, softcap 13) to re-establish the 0.9878 baseline, as recent architectural changes and aggressive LR tweaks have consistently yielded worse results or crashes, indicating the current local optimum is robust and further exploration should start from this known stable point.
